# Incentitours — full site summary

Incentitours, LLC. is a transnational travel company focused on cultural, nature, and adventure experiences in northern Mexico, especially Barrancas del Cobre (Copper Canyon), the Chepe Express train, and the Sierra Tarahumara. Operating since 1999 on the Creel–Barrancas del Cobre–Mar de Cortés circuit for travelers from Mexico, the United States, and Canada.

Website: https://incentitours.com.mx/
Language: Spanish (primary site content)

## Experiences

1. Barrancas del Cobre — One of the world's great canyon systems; viewpoints, cable car, and adventure park activities.
2. Tren Chepe Express — 350+ km through canyons, 87 tunnels and 37 bridges, from tropical climate to pine forests.
3. Tres culturas — Rarámuri, Mennonite, and mestizo cultures along the same journey.

## Destinations

### Divisadero (Parque de Aventura Barrancas del Cobre)
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/destinos/divisadero
Key stop on the Chepe Express with views of Urique, Tararecua, and Copper canyons. Adventure park with one of the world's longest cable cars (3 km), ZipRider, zip-line circuit, and via ferrata.

### Creel
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/destinos/creel
Pueblo Mágico and gateway to Copper Canyon in the Sierra Tarahumara; pine forests and living Rarámuri culture.

### Chihuahua Capital
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/destinos/chihuahua
Baroque cathedral, historic murals, eastern terminus of the Chepe; common starting point for Sierra trips.

### Cuauhtémoc
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/destinos/cuauhtemoc
Gateway to the Sierra; Mennonite region and “three cultures” (Rarámuri, Mennonite, mestizo); Spanish, English, and Plautdietsch.

### El Fuerte
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/destinos/el-fuerte
Pueblo Mágico in Sinaloa; colonial history, petroglyphs, protected natural area; ideal finish after the Chepe Express.

## Packages

### Barrancas Express — 3 days / 2 nights
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/paquetes/barrancas-express
Departures Monday and Saturday. Quick immersion in Sierra Tarahumara, Creel, canyon views, and Parque Aventura.

### Entre dos Pueblos Mágicos — 4 days / 3 nights
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/paquetes/entre-dos-pueblos-magicos
Departures Sunday and Friday. Creel and El Fuerte linked by Chepe Express; overnight in Copper Canyon.

### Altura y Aventura — 5 days / 4 nights
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/paquetes/altura-y-aventura
Departures Sunday, Thursday, and Tuesday. Chepe ascent from ~90 m to 2,300+ m; climate and biodiversity change.

### Cultural — 5 days / 4 nights
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/paquetes/cultural
Departures Thursday, Saturday, or Monday. Mennonite culture, Sierra Tarahumara, Parque Aventura, Chepe to El Fuerte.

### Espectacular — 6 days / 5 nights
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/paquetes/espectacular
Departures Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. Full Chepe and Sierra exploration with adventure park.

### Maravillosa — 7 days / 6 nights
URL: https://incentitours.com.mx/paquetes/maravillosa
Departures Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. Slower pace: Chihuahua, Creel, two nights in the canyons, Chepe, El Fuerte.

## Services

Chepe Express tickets, tours, gastronomic experiences, incentive travel, certified guides, cultural experiences, conferences and conventions, event logistics, bus/van rental, transfers. Own hotel: The Lodge at Creel Hotel & Spa (https://thelodgeatcreel.com/).
